query:
SELECT i.sponsorId, s.companyName, i.companyBoilerplate, i.keyChallenges, i.targetOrgSize
FROM intakeSubmissions i
JOIN sponsors s ON i.sponsorId = s.id
WHERE s.companyName = 'AI Limited'
LIMIT 1;
